generation.explanation: Think of x² + 6x as the area of a square with side x plus two rectangles of size x by 3 (the 6x split in half). Put them together and you get an L-shape with a missing corner. That corner is a 3 by 3 square with area 9. Adding it completes the big square of side (x+3), so x² + 6x + 9 = (x+3)², and therefore x² + 6x = (x+3)² − 9. Drag the slider to change x and see the pieces resize.
